'''Temporary Droids''' was a corporation active during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The company specialized in [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droids]] for private businesses. For groups that were in need of a large pool of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the company leased out droids for short or long-term rental, allowing businesses with limited resources to acquire a large pool of droid labor.<ref name="Kashyyyk in Flames" />

The president of Temporary Droids was [[Turren Lonarr]].<ref name="Kashyyyk in Flames" />
